notes.title: OnePunch 1.1.1 patch notes (Nov 21, 2024)
notes.content:
Hello from the team at CFK.

Thank you for all of the love and attention you've paid to casual action game OnePunch.

In order to create a richer, smoother gaming experience for players, patch 1.1.1 will be released today (11/21) with the following changes:


• More convenient controls.
 - Added the function for players to set keyboard action bindings.


• Addressed some issues and added various quality-of-life improvements.

We hope you'll experience this smoother version of OnePunch for yourself, and thank you to all of the people who have played OnePunch and visited our community page.

As always, thank you for your continued support as we at CFK strive to be the very best publisher we can be.

Thank you.

notes.title: OnePunch 1.1.0 patch notes (Jul 18, 2024)
notes.content:
Hello from the team at CFK.

Thank you for all of the love and attention you've paid to casual action game OnePunch.

In order to create a richer, smoother gaming experience for players, patch 1.1.0 will be released today (7/18) with the following changes:


 - Champion features added, such as AI matches, friendly matches, and more.
 - New functions for ranking added, such as championship rankings, personal record rankings, and more.


• More convenient controls for gamepad and keyboard.
 - Keyboard controls changed and new shortcuts added.
   (Please refer to the control mapping at the start of the game)
 - Made all menus more accessible.


• Fixed many bugs and added various quality-of-life improvements.

We hope you'll experience this smoother version of OnePunch for yourself, and thank you to all of the people who have played OnePunch and visited our community page.

As always, thank you for your continued support as we at CFK strive to be the very best publisher we can be.

Thank you.
